amendment_rule: Any change to the columns, their semantics, the embargo rule or the serialisation precision is a new contract version (WFV v3) and invalidates every lock that cites this one.

column_semantics.signal: float — model input, reads data <= date only
column_semantics.regimeVol: float — trailing volatility at date, conditioner

invariants: assert_no_leakage re-checks every training row, not only fold bounds
exactly one parameter is fitted: the sign of the signal, from training data
the information coefficient is cross-sectional within a date, then averaged
validate_contract rejects NaN, negative regimeVol and duplicate (date, asset)
single_implementation: igwt.features.contract.build_observations — every fixture, whatever its source, produces its observations through this one function
